newsitem.title: USA: Titan Q4 results reflect divestitures.
newsitem.headline: Titan Q4 results reflect divestitures.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc, reporting lower fourth quarter earnings and sales, said Tuesday results reflect the divestiture of assets of its non-core businesses, namely Automation International and Tractech, in the second and third quarters.
The 1996 quarter also included a one-time $1.3 million charge related to redemption of convertible subordinated notes.

Titan, a supplier of mounted tire and wheel systems for off-highway vehicles, posted fourth-quarter earnings of $4.7 million or $0.18 a diluted share compared to $9.7 million or $0.35 a diluted share. Quarterly sales fell to $144.6 million from $158.3 million.
